idea-plugin.name: Gist Do It
idea-plugin.description:
View and edit your GitHub gists from inside the IDE.

Browsing

  • Gists are grouped by category. Trailing words starting with # in a gist description, like 'Gist description #category1 #category2', are treated as categories.
  • Click a gist file to open it with syntax coloring based on its extension. Files of a gist already open are reused instead of opening another tab.
  • Double-click a gist to open all its files. All files of a gist open in a single editor group, a new one to the right if none of its files are open yet.
  • Load the public gists of any GitHub user.

Speed search

  • Press Cmd+F (Ctrl+F) or just start typing in the tree. Matches are highlighted and collapsed nodes are expanded.
  • Use Up and Down arrow keys for the previous and next match, Escape to close the search. A hint is shown below the tree while searching.

Editing your own gists

  • Files of your own gists open editable. Gists of other users open read-only.
  • Edited files show * in the tab and a banner with Save to Gist, Show Diff and Revert.
  • Changes are saved to GitHub only with Save to Gist, from the banner or the editor and editor tab context menus. A notification confirms the save, with a link to open the gist on GitHub.
  • If the file was changed on GitHub since you opened it, you are warned and can show a diff before deciding to overwrite.
  • Closing a tab with unsaved changes keeps them and offers to save, reopen or discard.

GitHub account

Uses the GitHub account you have already configured in the IDE under Settings | Version Control | GitHub. If no account is configured, the IDE's own GitHub login dialog (browser sign-in or personal access token) is shown, and the token is stored securely in the IDE password safe. If the bundled GitHub plugin is disabled, the plugin falls back to asking for a personal access token for the current session.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
New Features

  • Edit files of your own gists and save them back to GitHub with Save to Gist.
  • Warn when saving a file that was changed on GitHub since it was opened, with Show Diff.
  • Unsaved changes are marked with * in the tab and a banner with Save to Gist, Show Diff and Revert.
  • Save notification with time of save and link to open the gist on GitHub.
  • Closing a tab with unsaved changes keeps them and offers Save to Gist, Reopen or Discard.
  • Double-click a gist to open all its files in a single editor group.
  • Clicking a gist file that is already open selects its tab instead of opening another one.
  • Speed search hint below the tree while searching.
  • Load public gists of any GitHub user.
  • Speed search. Just start typing search string. Use up and down arrow keys to go to previous and next match. ESCAPE to cancel search.
  • Moved actions to Toolwindow title bar.
  • Notification while loading Gists.

Features

  • Show syntax coloring in Gist files based on the extension.
  • Support connect, disconnect and refresh gists action.
  • Wait cursor.

Bug Fixes

  • Speed search no longer closes after the first match on a gist file.
  • Double-clicking a gist no longer expands or collapses it.
  • Replace API scheduled for removal (SimpleListCellRenderer.create).
  • Fix icon size.
  • Fix tree cell background.
  • Use icons
